subject: Apply the look of Fujifilm Velvia 50 reversal (slide) film. See .rundeer/luts/fuji_velvia_50.md for the full LUT specification. Hyper-saturated greens and reds, deep inky shadows, ultra-sharp micro-contrast, punchy vivid colors especially in foliage and sky. Slight magenta bias in shadows, blue-shifted sky rendering, and that iconic high-chroma, near-garish but beautiful saturation. Colors should pop as if dye-transfer printed. Preserve all composition, lighting, and subject identity.
